limitations: One release sample; no mean/P95 or randomized attribution.
Native cold source build plus real remote restore included. No changed-code warm full release measured.
Job seconds are aggregate runner wall time, not CPU or billed-minute rounding.
Aggregate Java RSS double-counts shared pages; GC log covers whole Gradle daemon, not only R8.
